instrument.combined_measure: host PSS plus CUDA device memory in the same sample
instrument.cuda_process_isolation: every sample rejects compute allocations outside the selected tree
instrument.device_measure: sum of nvidia-smi used_memory for process-tree compute contexts
instrument.host_measure: sum of Linux smaps_rollup PSS for the process tree
instrument.swap_measure: system-wide host swap used before, during, and after capture; only attributable to the selected service on an otherwise isolated host
instrument.warning: For split memory, the combined value is an efficiency accounting metric, not a standalone fit guarantee; host and device peaks remain separate.
